regions.category: World > Western Asian & North African > Arab, Egyptian & Levantine > Egyptian & Southern Levantine
regions.description:

Nubians are an indigenous people of the Nile in southern Egypt and northern Sudan whose traditional languages include Nobiin and Kenzi. Many Egyptian Nubian communities were resettled north of Aswan in the 1960s when the Aswan High Dam flooded much of historic Nubia.

Many people in this Genetic Group report ancestors from Aswan. Many people in this Genetic Group report speaking Egyptian Arabic, and some people in this Genetic Group report speaking Nobiin and Sa'idi Arabic. You are connected through shared ancestors to people of North African descent primarily from the coastal region of the Tunisian Sahel.

Many people in this Genetic Group report ancestors from Sousse, Monastir, Moknine, Ksar Hellal, Jemmal, Mahdia, Téboulba, and Tunis. Many people in this Genetic Group report speaking Tunisian Arabic. Common maternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include L3e5, L1b1a and L1b1a5. Common paternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include E-V13, E-L618 and E-M183.

regions.name: Upper Soummam Basin
regions.category: World > Western Asian & North African > North African
regions.description:
You are connected through shared ancestors to people of North African descent primarily from a region around the upper Soummam River in the southern edge of Kabylia in Algeria, many of whom identify as Amazigh.

Many people in this Genetic Group report ancestors from Ighil Ali, El M'hir, Medjana, and Akbou. Many people in this Genetic Group report speaking Amazigh, and some people in this Genetic Group report speaking Kabyle. Common maternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include L3d1, L1b1a and L2a1. Common paternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include E-V65, E-V257 and E-M183.

regions.name: West-Central Tunisian Highlands
regions.category: World > Western Asian & North African > North African
regions.description:
You are connected through shared ancestors to people of North African descent primarily from a region from the Chott el Jerid basin to the northern Tunisian coast and west to the Aurès Mountains in Algeria.

Many people in this Genetic Group report ancestors from Gafsa, El Guettar, Degache, and Sidi Bouzid in Tunisia, and El Oued in Algeria. Many people in this Genetic Group report speaking Tunisian Arabic, and some people in this Genetic Group report speaking Algerian Saharan Arabic. Common maternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include L3e1, L3b1 and L2a1. Common paternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include E-M183, E-V65 and J-CTS5368.

regions.name: Western Algeria
regions.category: World > Western Asian & North African > North African
regions.description:
You are connected through shared ancestors to people of North African descent primarily from western Algeria, some of whom identify as Amazigh. This region stretches from the Tell Atlas Mountains and the Dahra Massif along the Mediterranean south to the Hautes Plaines and the M'zab Oases. This region's port cities have long connected the interior of Algeria to the wider Mediterranean.

Many people in this Genetic Group report ancestors from Tlemcen, Oran, Mascara, Tiaret, Cherchell, Mostaganem, Berriane, Ghardaïa, and Chlef. Many people in this Genetic Group report speaking Algerian Arabic. Common maternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include HV0, U6a and L2a1. Common paternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include E-M5021, E-V257 and E-M183.

regions.name: Western Algerian Coast
regions.category: World > Western Asian & North African > North African
regions.description:
You are connected through shared ancestors to people of North African descent primarily from the coastal plains and hills of western Algeria.

Many people in this Genetic Group report ancestors from Mascara, Mostaganem, Bou Kadir, Sig, Tiaret, and Oran. Many people in this Genetic Group report speaking Algerian Arabic. Common maternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include L1b, L1b1a and L2a1. Common paternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include E-V65, E-M5021 and E-M183.

regions.name: Western Anti-Atlas Mountains
regions.category: World > Western Asian & North African > North African
regions.description:
You are connected through shared ancestors to people of North African descent primarily from the western Anti-Atlas Mountains of southern Morocco, many of whom identify as Amazigh.

Many people in this Genetic Group report ancestors from Biougra, Ida Ougnidif, Ait Baha, and Tin Addi. Many people in this Genetic Group report speaking Tachelhit. Common maternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include L1b1a, L2c and L2a1l. Common paternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include T-L208, E-V257 and E-M183.

regions.name: Western Aurès Region
regions.category: World > Western Asian & North African > North African
regions.description:
You are connected through shared ancestors to people of North African descent primarily from the western Aurès region of northeastern Algeria, some of whom identify as Amazigh.

Many people in this Genetic Group report ancestors from Batna, Ouled Aouf, Merouana, Teleghma, Oued El Ma, and Ghassira. Many people in this Genetic Group report speaking Tachawit and Algerian Arabic. Common maternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include L2a1c3, L3h1b1 and L3h1a2a. Common paternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include E-L618, E-M5021 and E-M183.

regions.name: Western Gulf of Sirte Coast
regions.category: World > Western Asian & North African > North African
regions.description:
You are connected through shared ancestors to people of North African descent primarily from a region around the western coast of the Gulf of Sirte, particularly around the city of Misrata in northern Libya.

In addition to Misrata, many people in this Genetic Group report ancestors from Tripoli and Benghazi. Many people in this Genetic Group report speaking Libyan Arabic. Common maternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include L2a1a, L3e1 and L3h1b. Common paternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include E-M78, E-L677 and E-M183.

regions.name: Western High Atlas Mountains
regions.category: World > Western Asian & North African > North African
regions.description:
You are connected through shared ancestors to people of North African descent primarily from the western High Atlas Mountains of Morocco, many of whom identify as Amazigh.

Many people in this Genetic Group report ancestors from Taroudant, Imintanoute, Mzouda, Idouirane, Aoulouz, Ourika, Zagora, and Marrakesh. Many people in this Genetic Group report speaking Tachelhit and Moroccan Arabic, and some people in this Genetic Group report speaking Standard Moroccan Tamazight and Central Atlas Tamazight. Common maternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include L2a1, HV0 and U6a. Common paternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include E-M5021, E-V257 and E-M183.

regions.name: Western Libyan Coast
regions.category: World > Western Asian & North African > North African
regions.description:
You are connected through shared ancestors to people of North African descent primarily from the coastal region of northwestern Libya and nearby regions in Tunisia.

Many people in this Genetic Group report ancestors from Tripoli, Gharyan, Bani Walid, Az-Zawiyah, Janzur, and Khoms. Many people in this Genetic Group report speaking Libyan Arabic and Tunisian Arabic. Common maternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include L3h1b1, L3h1b and L2a1. Common paternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include E-V65, J-CTS5368 and E-M183.

regions.name: Western Petite Kabylie Region
regions.category: World > Western Asian & North African > North African
regions.description:
You are connected through shared ancestors to people of North African descent primarily from the western Petite Kabylie region in northern Algeria, some of whom identify as Kabyle.

Many people in this Genetic Group report ancestors from Seddouk, Bouhamza, Akbou, and Béjaïa. Many people in this Genetic Group report speaking Amazigh. Common maternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include U5b, L2a1 and L1b1a. Common paternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include J-L26, J-M67 and E-M183.

regions.name: Western Rif Mountains
regions.category: World > Western Asian & North African > North African
regions.description:
You are connected through shared ancestors to people of North African descent primarily from the western Rif Mountains of northern Morocco, some of whom identify as Rifian or Amazigh.

Many people in this Genetic Group report ancestors from Al Hoceima, Targuist, Beni Ammart, Tetouan, Tangier, El Jebha, and Bni Bouayach. Many people in this Genetic Group report speaking Tarifit and Moroccan Arabic. Common maternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include L1b, L3e5 and L1b1a. Common paternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include E-CTS736, E-V257 and E-M183.

regions.name: Zemmour Plateau
regions.category: World > Western Asian & North African > North African
regions.description:
You are connected through shared ancestors to people of North African descent primarily from the plateau between Rabat and Meknes in Morocco, some of whom identify as Amazigh.

Many people in this Genetic Group report ancestors from Khemisset, Salé, Tiflet, and Maaziz. Many people in this Genetic Group report speaking Moroccan Arabic, and some people in this Genetic Group report speaking Tamazight. Common maternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include L3d1-5, L3d1b1 and L1b1a. Common paternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include E-M5021, E-V257 and E-M183.

regions.name: Ziz Valley and Middle Atlas Mountains
regions.category: World > Western Asian & North African > North African
regions.description:
You are connected through shared ancestors to people of North African descent primarily from the Ziz Valley and the Middle Atlas Mountains of Morocco.

Many people in this Genetic Group report ancestors from Errachidia, Azrou, and Khenifra. Common maternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include K1a, U6a3 and L1b1a. Common paternal haplogroups in this Genetic Group include G-L91, J-CTS5368 and E-M183.
